title: Facing outcry over earthmover at high-altitude Sheshnag lake, BRO says ‘widening tracks for Amarnath Yatra pilgrims safety’ in J&K
description: The BRO statement came in the wake of severe criticism from Jammu and Kashmir’s political parties and locals over the use of the earthmover at the lake in Anantnag, after a video went viral on social media platforms
